reason: The marked paper and scissors suggest cutting the square to begin making a wind toy.
expectation: The scissors will cut the paper along its marks.

effect: The scissors turned the marked square into four cut blades, ready to be gathered.
reaction: The cuts make the wind-toy plan clearer.
reason: The corner-gathering hub sounds suited to bringing the paper blades together.
expectation: The hub will gather the blade corners into a pinwheel shape.

effect: The gathered corners form curved pockets that the breeze can push; the rotor now needs mounting.
reaction: The explanation of why the curved blades catch the breeze is satisfying.
reason: The capped axle and spacer should give the rotor a mounting that lets it turn.
expectation: The axle and spacer will attach to the rotor so it can spin.

effect: The rotor is now on its axle and appears ready to attach to the handle.
reaction: The mounting is progressing as expected.
reason: The handle has an axle clip that should hold the rotor.
expectation: The axle will clip onto the handle, making a handheld wind toy.

effect: The rotor and handle are assembled into a pinwheel, ready to test with moving air.
reaction: The assembly came together as expected.
reason: The hand fan can provide a breeze to test the pinwheel.
expectation: The fan's breeze will make the pinwheel spin.

effect: The fan test confirmed that the spaced axle lets the blades spin freely, completing the breeze-toy goal.
reaction: It was satisfying to see the assembled pinwheel work in both the fan and the garden breeze.

mostWorthwhile.text: Gathering the corners was most worthwhile: the explanation showed how curved pockets give the breeze something to push.

leastWorthwhile.text: Attaching the handle was straightforward and offered less to figure out than shaping or testing the rotor.

surprise.text: The explanation that alternate corners form curved pockets clarified how the flat paper becomes a wind-catching rotor.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary; the parts and their purposes were clear from their names and the construction sequence.

continue.text: Yes. The pinwheel's mechanism was interesting enough that I would be curious to see what the next construction teaches, though this chapter offered few difficult decisions.
